name: Silent House
source:
Our character is a normal high school student who goes to school routinely and helps his mother at home when he returns. He wants to succeed and save his mother from this life, but life has other plans.
Our main character is undecided in many ways, uncertain about his ideas and thoughts, and experiences intense emotions during these periods. All of these seem ordinary and normal…
But no one around you is normal, everyone has suppressed emotions, and you will progress according to the responses you give in your dialogues with them. Ethics, a very relative concept… Everything will proceed in the direction you want.
translation:
我们的角色是一名普通的高中生，他定期去学校，回来后帮助他的母亲在家。他想成功并把他的母亲从这种生活中拯救出来，但生活有其他的计划。
我们的主角在很多方面都犹豫不决，不确定自己的想法和想法，并在这些时期经历强烈的情绪。这一切看似平凡又正常……
但你周围没有一个人是正常的，每个人都有压抑的情绪，你会根据你在与他们对话中给出的反应而进步。伦理，一个非常相对的概念……一切都会按照你想要的方向进行。
